title_o: Emotional Expression in Simple Line Drawings of a Robot's Face Leads to Higher Offers in the Ultimatum Game

replications.quote: The results revealed that the ratings of the donation were significantly higher (F(1, 94) = 5.69, p = 0.019, ηp2 = 0.06) in the changing facial expression condition (M = 456.4, SD = 320.0) than in the static condition (M = 312.8, SD = 274.4)
